candidateObjective.description: Stop the designated black a-pawn from promoting.

recommendationRationale: Three-piece exact coverage, clear pawn-square lesson, three defensive first moves, compact capture terminal, and a truthful losing boundary.

pruningRules: expand three initial WDL-preserving learner moves
after the first move follow one deterministic learner choice per opponent-policy line
retain and classify every locally validated provider move at every expanded node
stop on pawn capture, promotion, repetition, missing policy move, or ply bound

opponentPolicyCandidates.algorithm: preserve WDL; prefer provider DTZ optimum; lexicographic UCI tie-break
opponentPolicyCandidates.failureBehavior: neutral technical-unavailable when no bound reply exists

opponentPolicyCandidates.algorithm: preserve WDL; maximize absolute DTZ; lexicographic UCI tie-break
opponentPolicyCandidates.failureBehavior: neutral technical-unavailable when no bound reply exists

opponentPolicyCandidates.algorithm: human selects from locally validated WDL-preserving replies; UCI is explicit per node

successConditionCandidates.edgeCases: must distinguish temporary blockade from permanent stop

successConditionCandidates.stalemate: may qualify only if explicitly approved

hintCandidates.text: Use the square of the pawn and bring the king into its path.
Move toward the a-file before the pawn advances too far.
Reveal the candidate learner move for the current node.

correctDefensiveProgress.text: Good. The king stays inside the pawn’s stopping route.

promotionPrevented.text: The approved evidence shows that the designated pawn can no longer promote.

offRoute.text: That legal move may still hold, but it leaves the proposed instructional route.

defenseLost.text: The bounded tablebase evidence shows that the pawn can no longer be stopped.

opponentAdvance.text: The pawn advances along the selected candidate policy.

technicalUnavailable.text: The position could not be verified. This is not learner failure.

retry.text: The reviewed position has been restored.

successSummary.text: You stopped the designated pawn without allowing promotion.
